regulatory_body: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
asset_classes_available: Equity (E), Corporate Bonds (C), Government Securities (G), Alternative Assets (A)
tier_structure: Tier I (Retirement lock-in account) & Tier II (Voluntary liquid investment account)
tax_benefits: Up to ₹1.5L under Sec 80C + exclusive ₹50,000 deduction under Sec 80CCD(1B); employer contribution under Sec 80CCD(2)
annuity_requirement: Minimum 40% of corpus at age 60 must purchase an annuity providing lifelong pension; remaining 60% is 100% tax-free lump sum
exit_rules: Partial withdrawal up to 25% of self-contribution permitted after 3 years for specific contingencies (marriage, education, illness, house purchase)
